title: SIFT correspondence sensitivity to the coordinate-distance threshold
aggregation: Compute an arithmetic mean within each dataset, then average the four dataset means with equal weight (30/45/55/55 pairs; 185 total).
caption_note: Identical SIFT and matching settings are used before and after dehazing: nfeatures=2000, nOctaveLayers=3, contrastThreshold=0.04, edgeThreshold=10, sigma=1.6, L2 nearest-neighbor matching, and Lowe ratio 0.75. Correctness uses coordinate distance in registered image pairs; no geometric transform is fitted. Precision and unique-reference-keypoint recovery are imagewise ratios before aggregation. This is a feature-correspondence diagnostic, not object-detection AP.

protocol.experiment: Frozen SIFT feature correspondence after dehazing
protocol.hypothesis: Restoration can make reference-consistent local features more recoverable; additional keypoints alone do not establish this.

matching.geometry: Identity geometry of registered pairs; Euclidean distance between matched keypoint coordinates. No RANSAC fitting to improve scores.

protocol.empty_case_policy: Zero accepted matches gives zero precision; zero reference features gives zero recovery and a separate flag. Count every case.
protocol.aggregation: Arithmetic image means, reported per dataset and equal dataset macro; no seed comparison.
protocol.limitations: A fixed local-feature downstream diagnostic; not target-detection AP, not a registration benchmark with unknown camera transforms.
